acceptance_criteria.expected_result: Baseline digest mismatch blocks incremental-value proof.

alternatives.fail_closed: Missing/rewritten baseline or unsupported claimed delta blocks incremental-value acceptance; lack of genuine uplift is reported rather than fabricated.
alternatives.idempotency: Baseline digest and evidence-bound deltas are deterministic for an exact source/input snapshot.
alternatives.operational_cost: Small extra structured context plus one isolated judge dimension.
alternatives.prevention: Strong: proves whether research changed the design or discovered additional material value.
alternatives.recoverability: Schema/judge extension can be rolled back without rewriting historical outputs.
alternatives.reuse: Reuses research_assurance, challenger_review, omission discovery and the existing semantic judge.

alternatives.blast_radius: Creates a parallel reasoning layer and additional failure/cost surface.
alternatives.complexity: High; introduces another model call and coordination path.

alternatives.fail_closed: Requires another authority/judge boundary to avoid self-certification.
alternatives.idempotency: Lower because of an additional stochastic producer.
alternatives.operational_cost: High tokens/latency and ongoing eval burden.
alternatives.prevention: Can increase idea diversity but does not itself prove utility.
alternatives.recoverability: Operationally removable but leaves extra integration debt.
alternatives.reuse: Low relative to the existing challenger mechanism.

alternatives.description: Keep producer behavior unchanged and compare final output against a withheld baseline only after generation with a blinded pairwise judge.
alternatives.fail_closed: Can block acceptance on no measurable uplift but may over-penalize cases where no better solution exists.
alternatives.idempotency: Good when baseline and judge rubric are revision-bound.
alternatives.operational_cost: One extra judge comparison for deep holdouts.
alternatives.prevention: Good measurement but weak prevention because the producer still has no explicit discovery-delta discipline.

causal_chain.statement: The user objective includes finding stronger current techniques and useful solutions that were not already obvious from the starting problem.
SRCR enters DEEP_ARCHITECTURE_RESEARCH and requires current-practice research, at least three challenges and omission discovery.
The contract records only the final research_assurance state; it does not bind a before-research solution snapshot to the final solution.
The semantic utility floor checks research_complete, external evidence, challenge count and first_solution_disposition, but does not verify a material final-minus-baseline delta.
Consequently a strong but expected solution can pass both floors without demonstrating incremental value from research/challenge.

challenger_review.challenge: Would a mandatory NOVEL_SOLUTION_DISCOVERY/WOW field solve the observed weakness?
challenger_review.resolution: No. It would convert a useful qualitative objective into a visible proxy the producer can game. Replace novelty requirement with immutable baseline-to-material-value delta proof and allow honest NO_MATERIAL_UPLIFT.

challenger_review.challenge: Can a post-hoc pairwise judge alone prove the desired capability?
challenger_review.resolution: Use it as a holdout/quality measurement, but not as the sole repair: the producer also needs an evidence-bound record of what research changed so the reasoning process is auditable and reusable.

challenger_review.challenge: Should a second discovery agent be introduced to force more diverse ideas?
challenger_review.resolution: No by default. Existing challenger/research machinery is sufficient; a second producer adds latency, context and another authority boundary without proving utility.

challenger_review.challenge: Would requiring MATERIAL_UPLIFT for every deep case improve quality?
challenger_review.resolution: No. Some baselines are already optimal under available evidence. The contract must distinguish successful search with NO_MATERIAL_UPLIFT from failure to search or unsupported uplift.

illegal_transitions: LEGACY_READABLE cannot jump directly to VALUE_PROOF_REQUIRED_DEEP.
Producer-authored MATERIAL_UPLIFT cannot jump directly to QUALITY_ACCEPTED.
UNPROVEN incremental value cannot be relabeled as MATERIAL_UPLIFT without independent evidence.
recovery_paths: If holdouts fail, return to VALUE_PROOF_OPTIONAL and keep prior quality path intact.
If the independent judge is miscalibrated, disable only incremental-value acceptance and preserve captured baseline/delta evidence.
terminal_conditions: QUALITY_ACCEPTED for a deep case requires normal SRCR quality plus a valid MATERIAL_UPLIFT or NO_MATERIAL_UPLIFT classification; LIGHTWEIGHT remains outside this extra gate.

first_bad_control.statement: The first missing preventive control is immediately before research/challenger execution: SRCR does not freeze a compact pre-research leading solution baseline against which later discoveries must be compared.

hard_guard.control: SRCR_INCREMENTAL_VALUE_PROOF at research finalization and canonical semantic quality decision.
hard_guard.fail_closed_condition: For a material research path, block incremental-value acceptance when the pre-research baseline is absent/stale, a claimed adopted delta has no evidence/material effect, or the producer rewrites the baseline after research. Do not block merely because the honest outcome is NO_MATERIAL_UPLIFT.
hard_guard.observable_result: Every deep/bounded research result reports MATERIAL_UPLIFT, NO_MATERIAL_UPLIFT or UNPROVEN with exact baseline and evidence-bound deltas; no self-authored WOW score is accepted.

historical_regressions.observed_failure: The blind lifecycle run passed both pre-quality floors and produced a strong expected architecture, yet the output contained no immutable pre-research baseline or independently verifiable claim showing what material value research/challenge added beyond that baseline.
The semantic utility source checks research completeness, external refs, first-solution disposition and challenger count but not final-minus-baseline incremental utility.

immediate_cause.statement: The profile requires research, alternatives and challenger review, but it does not preserve an immutable pre-research solution baseline or require evidence-bound comparison between that baseline and the final design; therefore research completion can be proven without proving incremental utility.

implementation_delta.action: ADD a mandatory pre-research baseline freeze for material research paths plus a bounded adjacent-value scan across existing-capability reuse, deletion/simplification, hidden risk, context/performance, operability and second-order effects. Explicitly allow NO_MATERIAL_UPLIFT.
implementation_delta.rationale: Research cannot demonstrate incremental value unless the before state is preserved; forcing novelty would create a gameable proxy.

implementation_delta.action: EXTEND research_assurance with baseline_solution_snapshot/baseline_digest, discovery_deltas and incremental_value_outcome={MATERIAL_UPLIFT,NO_MATERIAL_UPLIFT,UNPROVEN}; each delta carries category, trigger evidence, baseline gap, final design refs, material effect, tradeoff and ADOPTED/REJECTED disposition.
implementation_delta.rationale: Makes final-minus-baseline value explicit and machine-addressable without a subjective WOW score.

implementation_delta.action: ADD structural coherence for immutable baseline/deltas and an isolated semantic dimension that verifies material utility; producer cannot self-award uplift. A missing/unsupported delta blocks incremental-value acceptance, while honest NO_MATERIAL_UPLIFT remains valid.
implementation_delta.rationale: Separates deterministic shape from independent semantic usefulness and avoids rewarding novelty theater.

implementation_delta.action: ADD blind holdouts for real uplift, no-uplift, novelty theater, hidden risk and context-budget cases; compare pre-research baseline and final output with shuffled/blinded ordering where useful.
implementation_delta.rationale: The mechanism must prove it discovers useful additional value without learning to satisfy a visible answer key.

architecture_decisions.decision: Represent it as independently verifiable incremental utility relative to an immutable pre-research baseline, not as a novelty score.
architecture_decisions.question: How should SRCR represent 'wow' without forcing novelty?
architecture_decisions.rationale: Useful discovery is a delta in solution quality/risk/reuse/cost, while novelty alone is a gameable proxy.

architecture_decisions.decision: Emit NO_MATERIAL_UPLIFT with evidence and keep the repair eligible for overall quality acceptance if all normal obligations close.
architecture_decisions.question: What happens when research finds no material improvement?
architecture_decisions.rationale: Forcing an uplift in every case rewards fabrication and undermines correctness.

architecture_decisions.decision: The producer describes and evidences deltas; the independent semantic quality boundary determines materiality/acceptance for the exact baseline and final candidate.
architecture_decisions.question: Who may determine that a claimed delta is material?
architecture_decisions.rationale: Prevents producer self-certification and aligns with isolated grader practice.

context_transport.degradation_rule: At hard limit, deduplicate evidence and hydrate by ref; never drop baseline identity or material delta evidence.
context_transport.delivery_strategy: Inline compact baseline/delta metadata; hydrate exact supporting research/evidence by ref only when the independent judge needs it.
jit_refs: exact source snippets for disputed delta
context_transport.rationale: The new proof should add only compact baseline/delta structures and refs, not full research documents.

token_budget.measurement_method: UTF8_BYTES_DIV_4 for incremental value packet only

control_matrix.purpose: Prevent post-hoc rewriting of the first plausible solution after research is seen.

control_matrix.observable_result: Material uplift, honest no-uplift or unproven is explicitly derived.
control_matrix.purpose: Require each claimed improvement to identify what changed and why it is materially useful.

decision_closure.closure_statement: The repair fixes the measurement target (incremental utility, not novelty), the baseline capture point, delta schema, independent semantic authority, anti-gaming tests, compatibility path and context budget. Implementation has no remaining architectural choice.

Add blinded holdouts and anti-gaming mutations for uplift/no-uplift/context cost.

observability_plan.alert_or_gate: Alert on sudden disappearance after rubric changes.

observability_plan.alert_or_gate: Gate if hard budget is exceeded.

policy_contract_changes.change: Require baseline freeze and adjacent-value scan only when research/challenge is material; prohibit fabricated novelty and producer-authored WOW scores.
policy_contract_changes.compatibility_rule: LIGHTWEIGHT cases remain exempt; V0.2 historical outputs remain readable.

policy_contract_changes.change: Add independent incremental-value materiality decision bound to exact baseline/final/evidence revisions.
policy_contract_changes.compatibility_rule: Overall quality and incremental-value are separate dimensions; NO_MATERIAL_UPLIFT is not an automatic overall failure.

wiring.fail_closed_behavior: No incremental-value claim can be accepted without immutable baseline.

wiring.precondition: Baseline digest is frozen and current.

wiring.fail_closed_behavior: Producer cannot self-award MATERIAL_UPLIFT; judge returns material uplift, no material uplift or unproven.

invariant.statement: For every SRCR case where current-practice research or challenger work is material, the final design must be compared against an immutable pre-research leading-solution baseline; claimed incremental value is accepted only when an independent semantic boundary can trace a material final-minus-baseline delta to evidence. Genuine NO_MATERIAL_UPLIFT is allowed and must never be converted into fabricated novelty.

inspected_surfaces: frozen source-only blind-run artifact and validation readback

next_gate.exit_condition: Contract/schema/producer/judge changes pass generic anti-gaming regressions, then the original lifecycle case and unrelated deep/simple holdouts are rerun without exposing the expected improvements.

Freeze a pre-research baseline and prevent post-hoc mutation before evaluating final-minus-baseline deltas.

Keep JIT/high-signal evidence transport; only compact baseline/delta structures are added.
Wire baseline capture -> research/challenger -> delta materialization -> independent semantic materiality judgment -> quality receipt.
Adopt optional then required value-proof fields only for material research paths; preserve V0.2/simple-case compatibility.
No new stateful runtime is created; existing profile update rollback semantics remain sufficient.
Track material-uplift, no-material-uplift, unsupported-delta blocks, judge disagreement and added token/latency cost.
Keep producer unable to self-issue quality acceptance; material uplift is judged at the independent quality boundary.
Bound adjacent-value search and stop when new evidence no longer creates material deltas; do not hydrate unrelated policies/EKB/READMEs.
Add blind anti-gaming holdouts covering real uplift, no-uplift and novelty theater.
Version the value-delta rubric and periodically calibrate independent judge decisions against expert review.

recurrence_evidence.fact: The blind lifecycle run produced a mature architecture and passed deterministic/semantic utility floors without a separately evidenced final-minus-baseline value delta.
The current utility floor validates research/challenge presence and closure but contains no baseline-to-delta incremental-value control.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Optimizing directly for novelty/WOW makes the metric gameable and creates pressure to invent novelty rather than improve utility; current research on grader gaming supports avoiding such visible proxy targets.
A second producer adds cost and a parallel reasoning layer while the existing research/challenger path can carry the needed baseline-to-delta discipline.
Useful as a holdout evaluation, but insufficient as the sole repair because it measures uplift after the fact without making the producer explain and evidence what research actually changed.

research_assurance.external_research_rationale: Agent-evaluation design and grader-gaming controls materially affect how an incremental-value requirement should be implemented; current 2026 guidance changes the design away from a visible novelty score.

patterns_compared.fit: High: incremental utility should be judged as a separate dimension rather than inferred from overall spec correctness.
patterns_compared.tradeoff: Requires periodic expert calibration and clear materiality anchors.

patterns_compared.fit: High: a visible mandatory novelty target can be gamed, so the producer must not self-award WOW and holdouts should conceal answer-key details.
patterns_compared.tradeoff: Requires hidden/adversarial fixtures and careful evaluator design.

patterns_compared.fit: High for validating whether discovered value survives the real LF source/authority context rather than only a synthetic rubric.
patterns_compared.pattern: Independent evaluation grounded in realistic workflow/environment
patterns_compared.tradeoff: Holdout setup must include the relevant real resources without leaking expected answers.

research_questions: How can SRCR measure useful value gained from research/challenge without forcing novelty or letting the producer self-grade?
How should agent evals distinguish genuine task improvement from grader gaming, decorative novelty and evaluation awareness?
How can the additional evaluation remain isolated and bounded so it does not inflate every profile execution?

residual_risks.risk: An explicit incremental-value target can still become a proxy and induce novelty theater if the producer sees a simplistic grader; keep materiality judgment independent and use hidden holdouts.
Pairwise uplift judgments remain partially subjective; calibrate the isolated judge against periodic human expert review rather than turning it into sole authority.

should_exist_assessment.elimination_impact: No legitimate capability is lost by refusing a separate novelty engine; the existing SRCR producer and independent semantic quality boundary already contain the correct places to generate and verify incremental value.
should_exist_assessment.native_or_existing_alternative: Extend the existing research/challenger trajectory with an immutable pre-research baseline and evidence-bound value deltas, then let the existing independent semantic quality boundary verify material uplift. Do not add a second engine, runtime or authority.
should_exist_assessment.subject: a separate WOW/novelty engine or second discovery authority

solution_depth.rationale: The defect is in the profile's own research/quality architecture and changes producer contract, semantic judge behavior, regression strategy and migration semantics; a local wording change would merely create another gameable checklist.

symptom.statement: A deep-research SRCR run can satisfy the current structural and semantic utility floors while producing a solution that is correct and comprehensive but does not demonstrate any material value gained beyond the pre-research plausible solution.

systemic_root_cause.statement: SRCR currently treats research/challenge as process-completeness obligations rather than as a baseline-to-delta value proof. The producer may declare the first solution REVISED and list external patterns, while the validators only verify presence, closure and consistency; no independent control proves which material risks, reuse opportunities, simplifications, performance gains or design changes were actually discovered because of research/challenge.

transition_plan.compatibility_rule: Existing V0.2 outputs remain readable. During migration, V0.3 deep/bounded research cases may emit the new structures before enforcement; simple LIGHTWEIGHT cases do not need an artificial value-delta search.

changes: Add baseline/delta/outcome structures and explicit anti-forced-novelty semantics.

stages.rollback_scope: Revert new optional schema/contract fields only.

stages.exit_condition: No overconstraint on simple cases; material uplift is found when available; no fabricated novelty when unavailable.
stages.rollback_scope: Keep feature non-promoted and return failures to producer/judge design.

transition_plan.strategy: Introduce baseline/delta evidence in backward-compatible stages, then require it only where research/challenge is materially invoked; do not make novelty a universal gate.
